summary.intent: Evaluate how well the wisp-plugins set works for front-end work and design ideation by auditing past orin-dx/techworx site sessions, then act on the findings: add exploration modes, gate hooks, context-hygiene rules, merge the review-slop branch, and improve the courier plugin (changesets, commit-analyzer, pr-narrator).
summary.outcome: Four parallel audits showed the plugins are too rigid for exploratory design work and lack visual/render coverage. The follow-up work delivered a context-measurement tool, a context-hygiene reference for smith, a merge of the review-slop branch, and courier 3.1.0 (changeset@3, release-artifact@3, updated commit-analyzer and pr-narrator), all committed locally and not pushed.

repo: Plugin set is a spec-driven lifecycle (weaver, vanguard, scribe/muse, navigator, smith, courier) with typed JSON handoffs in shared/schemas and default-fail gates; no plugin has a browser, screenshot or visual mode.
Published schemas are immutable under ADR 004, so removing the changeset summary length cap required new changeset@3 and release-artifact@3 rather than editing @2.
muse docs reference a ranger accessibility hazard taxonomy that does not exist; spec@1 has no fields for tokens, layout, breakpoints or visual intent.
Agent descriptions have a 450-character routing limit checked by scripts/check-platform-limits.py.

Codex counterparts under harnesses/codex are generated via `just marketplace-sync`; catalog.json and plugin.json versions must be kept in sync, and `just check` and `just claude-validate` are the verification commands.
The review-slop branch cuts dropped the closing </backstory> tag in scribe/drift-checker; both branches independently added tools/transcript-metrics.py and moved the muse exit-gate to verdict@3.

In the audited pages sessions, ~810 files were mostly subagent transcripts; only about 2 top-level sessions in orin-dx and 1-2 in pages used plugin agents; ideation ran via Artifacts, forks and general-purpose agents.
Context measurement: Bash is ~60% of all characters (output plus inline script text), whole-page Artifact reads are the largest single results, and delegation prompts are only 3%.
Plugin `shared/...` reference paths resolve relative to the plugin, not the agent's working directory, so agents can fail to find references like changesets.md even on correct installs.
workflow: Sandbox blocks GPG signing, writes under ~/.claude/jobs/, and GitHub API calls; user approved running git commits outside the sandbox, scripts go in $TMPDIR (/tmp/claude-501).
Subagent reports are unverified model output; user hypotheses were passed to running agents via SendMessage to test them against evidence.
The `claude -p` guard refuses `$(...)` substitution; pass prompts inline or have the model read a prompt file.
Git add -A sometimes needed to be issued as a separate command from the commit.
Merging two overlapping branches once was chosen over rebasing to resolve conflicts a single time.

friction: Initial session count was wrong (~810 sessions) because most were subagent transcripts.
Plugin specs and gates churned on wording-only blockers (SPEC-001 needed 13 verdicts) and did not catch visual defects; orchestrator ignored the 3-retry escalation cap.
Sandbox blocked GPG signing, the job directory and the gh API, requiring workarounds.
Merging review-slop conflicted in 10 files, including duplicated transcript-metrics and muse gate changes.
Some git add/commit chains were refused and had to be split.
The courier analyzer in the live run could not find its changesets.md reference due to path resolution.
open_items: Push the branch and open a draft PR (awaiting user go-ahead).
Review and approve ADR 011 (exploration modes) and ADR 012 (handback gate hook); run the other four gates (scribe, smith, sentinel, ranger) live.
Investigate how the host resolves plugin shared/... paths and fix.
Wave 2 gate hygiene (evidence-citing blockers, wording-only blockers as notes), then Waves 3-5 (spec@2, render evidence, critic agents, prompt ablations, AGENTS.md).
Extend the context-hygiene rule to ranger, sentinel, muse, scribe and measure its effect; outcome-level plans in navigator/planner; move exploration record shapes out of skill bodies and re-pilot.
Callisto repo recommendations (AGENTS.md invoking courier skills, PR template changeset prompt) not applied; user's installed courier 3.0.3 stays broken until release and reinstall.
`just fmt-check` not run; paired comparison of exploration modes on a real design task still needed.
